posts.title: Is your water heater near the end?
posts.excerpt: Four signs it is time to replace it, before it floods the garage.
posts.body_md:
Most **tank water heaters** last 10 to 12 years.

## Signs it is time

- Rusty or *cloudy* hot water
- Rumbling or popping sounds
- A small puddle under the tank

Not sure? [Book a free check](https://book.example/copper-line).
